name: GDAS conventional observations
model_or_instrument: Surface and radiosonde observations (ADPUPA and ADPSFC BUFR)
size_as_stated: over 3000 surface and 400 radiosonde observations every 12 hours throughout 2017
resolution: Station locations interpolated to 1.4° grid, 12-hour intervals
access: The GDAS observational BUFR files can be accessed via the NCEI Archive Information Request System (AIRS) at https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/has/HAS.DsSelect.

scales.note: GDAS surface (ADPSFC) and radiosonde (ADPUPA) observations for 2017 interpolated to the 1.4-degree model grid at 12-hour intervals.
